future_implementation_breakdown: Define durable window stage fingerprints and deterministic window IDs.
Add a single-pass-compatible multi-pass runner behind an explicit opt-in setting.
Persist per-window artifact metadata through StageStore without a second job system.
Add global aggregation, cross-window deduplication, and diversity selection.
Add provider-budget accounting and context-error fallback for window-level requests.
Verify parity for existing single-pass users and progressive rollout behavior.
interpretation_warnings: SYNTHETIC EVALUATION ONLY: results are not real-world performance measurements.
Gold spans are authored annotations for controlled scenarios, not objective human judgments.
Canned LLM responses simulate selection from visible candidates; no live provider was called.
Topic labels are diagnostics and were not supplied to production ranking.
Sparse transcripts lower segment-coverage ratios by design and do not measure ASR quality.
known_limitations: The corpus is small and cannot estimate production quality across real content distributions.
Boundary errors are measured only for matched spans; unmatched moments are not localized.
Greedy IoU matching can prefer a slightly better overlapping pair over a globally optimal assignment.
Religious fixtures test context-preservation structure only; no religious profile is implemented.
Simulated multi-pass discovery reuses deterministic candidates and does not exercise a real LLM.

limit_demonstrations.evidence: A synthetic 200519 character transcript exposes 176519 hidden characters.
limit_demonstrations.interpretation: Late context cannot be selected by the single LLM pass.

limit_demonstrations.interpretation: Segment visibility ends before the end of a long video.

limit_demonstrations.interpretation: Candidate caps are global in the current single-pass path.

metric_definitions.boundary_error: Absolute start and end timestamp differences for greedily matched spans.
metric_definitions.candidate_survival: Stage after-count divided by stage before-count and by the largest stage before-count.
metric_definitions.cap_statistics: Candidates hidden by the 12-candidate LLM cap and highlights hidden by the max_highlights cap.
metric_definitions.context_truncation: Difference between full transcript text/segments and the first 24,000 characters or first 2,000 segments.
metric_definitions.distinct_topic_coverage: Fraction of authored gold topics with at least one matched selected span.
metric_definitions.f1: Harmonic mean of precision and recall.
metric_definitions.fallback_frequency: Fraction of canned LLM calls that produced no usable highlights and used deterministic fallback.
metric_definitions.precision: Matched predictions divided by valid predictions; 1.0 when both prediction and gold sets are empty.
metric_definitions.quartile_coverage: Selected span seconds intersecting each quartile divided by gold seconds in that quartile, capped at 1.0.
metric_definitions.recall: Matched gold spans divided by valid gold spans; 1.0 when gold is empty.
metric_definitions.redundancy: Pairwise IoU among selected spans, including count of pairs with positive overlap.
metric_definitions.span_iou: Intersection divided by union of two absolute-time spans; invalid intervals score zero.
metric_definitions.temporal_distribution: Counts and seconds of selected spans by midpoint quartile.

multi_pass_design: Partition the complete transcript into sequential windows with configurable overlap.
Preserve absolute timestamps for every segment and candidate; never rebase window-local times.
Analyze each window independently with bounded text, segment, and candidate input.
Persist window status, attempts, fingerprint, and candidate artifact in the existing StageStore.
Resume from the first incomplete or invalid window while retaining completed window results.
Aggregate all successful window candidates before global deduplication and semantic consolidation.
Apply final ranking, diversity selection, and max_highlights only after full-video discovery.
Treat 24,000 characters and 2,000 segments as per-window limits, not global discovery limits.

recommended.rationale: Selected by the deterministic experiment score: mean F1, 0.25 times gold-span match ratio, minus 0.1 times redundancy, minus a small window-count penalty.
